decision.FP8: deferred outside grant 1 unless a reviewed successor passes every qualification gate before launch

reason: FP8 is optional and currently unqualified on GH200; freezing bf16 removes it from the pre-grant critical path without spending undeclared GPU hours or weakening mandatory evidence
required_bf16_qualification: finite forward backward and optimizer behavior
exact-shape memory and achieved end-to-end throughput
FP8_successor_requirements: GH200 numerical parity and finite-value gates
measured end-to-end throughput and memory benefit
explicit project-owner adoption without consuming protected reserve
